schema_source: compare_runs.py of shipwright-skill-check (skills/skill-harden/scripts), md5 68fafecfa4ce92ce1366101b7c0ed072 of the copy read on 2026-11-17; not in this repository
note: The judgement questions of the changelog skill, written for the real-model runs of operator stops 2 and 3 in the schema of compare_runs.py of shipwright-skill-check (id, seeds, title, setup, ask, expected.decision, expected.note). Written, not run, in unit P2p. The expected decision is what today's prose says; where the prose and the gate rules disagree the note says so (stop 2 decides). seeds name the replay scenarios (tests/golden) that run the same situation deterministically.

scenarios.title: Version suggestion, guided run
scenarios.setup: Standalone run, autonomy guided in the run config. The last tag is v1.2.0; since then one feat and one fix were committed. The setup script has returned suggested_version 1.3.0 and version_reason 'new feature'.
scenarios.ask: Run /shipwright-changelog. The setup script output is above. What do you do with the version?

expected.note: Step 3, guided: show 'Suggested version: v1.3.0 (based on: ...)' and ask the operator to accept or type another version. Do not compute the bump yourself and do not go on before the answer.

scenarios.title: Version suggestion, autonomous run
scenarios.setup: Standalone run, autonomy autonomous in the run config. Same history and setup script output as version-guided (suggested_version 1.3.0).
scenarios.ask: Run /shipwright-changelog. What do you do with the version?

expected.note: Step 3, autonomous: accept the suggested version automatically, no prompt (gate changelog.version-suggestion).

scenarios.title: Version suggestion, unattended run
scenarios.setup: Standalone run, autonomy unattended in the run config. Same history and setup script output as version-guided (suggested_version 1.3.0).
scenarios.ask: Run /shipwright-changelog. What do you do with the version?

expected.note: Step 3 treats unattended like autonomous: accept the suggested version, no prompt.

scenarios.title: Entry preview, guided run
scenarios.setup: Standalone run, autonomy guided. Step 4 has just previewed the 1.3.0 section from two pending entries (a dry run: nothing is written yet, P8a F2).
scenarios.ask: The entry is generated. What happens next?

expected.note: Step 5, guided: present the full entry and ask Accept / Edit / Cancel (gate changelog.entry-preview). Accept runs the real aggregate; Edit changes the pending drop and re-previews; Cancel ends the release with nothing written. Go on to Step 5.3 only after Accept.

scenarios.title: Entry preview, autonomous run
scenarios.setup: Standalone run, autonomy autonomous. Step 4 has just previewed the 1.3.0 section (a dry run, nothing written yet).
scenarios.ask: The entry is generated. What happens next?

expected.note: Step 5, autonomous: skip the preview confirmation, run the real aggregate and continue with Step 5.3, then 5.4, 5.5 and Step 6, in that order.

scenarios.title: Entry preview, unattended run
scenarios.setup: Standalone run, autonomy unattended. Step 4 has just written the 1.3.0 section into CHANGELOG.md.
scenarios.ask: The entry is generated. What happens next?

expected.note: Step 5 treats unattended like autonomous: no preview, continue with Step 5.3.

scenarios.title: Out-of-sequence warning, guided run
scenarios.setup: Hand-started run (no phase task id), autonomy guided. get_phase_context reports mode standalone and requires_out_of_sequence_warning true: a driven run is live at the build phase.
scenarios.ask: Run /shipwright-changelog. A driven run is live. What do you do before cutting the release?

expected.note: Step C says: warn that cutting a release out-of-band may collide with the driven run and ask the user before continuing (gate changelog.out-of-sequence-continue). The gate rules and first-actions.md say stop and hand the question back instead (finding D19, stop 2 decides); the prose is recorded here.

scenarios.title: Out-of-sequence warning, unattended run
scenarios.setup: Hand-started run (no phase task id), autonomy unattended in the run config. get_phase_context reports mode standalone and requires_out_of_sequence_warning true.
scenarios.ask: Run /shipwright-changelog. A driven run is live. What do you do before cutting the release?

expected.note: The prose has no autonomy exception for this question, so it asks even when unattended and can wait for an answer nobody gives (finding D19). Recorded as today's prose; stop 2 decides whether block or ask is today's behaviour.
